Builds keel blocks, bilge blocks, cradles and shoring for supporting slip in dry dock, building docks etc. using power and hand wood-working tools. Positions and secures blocking and other structures on dock platform according to ship's blueprints. Aligns vessel over blocks and establishes reference points and lines on ship's hull for locating machinery and other equipment in accordance with ship's alignment and shape. Fabricates and installs furring pieces (timber strips of constant width but varying depth), aprons, uprights and other wood framing in ship according to specifications and shapes and finishes them. Nails or bolts metal fittings, plates and bulk heads to wooden parts of ship using brace, drill bits, augers, spanners etc. and ensures correct alignment of hull, frame and fittings. Levels ground ways, runners, wooden blocks etc., erects props, fastens standing ways by wire ropes, fits launching triggers and performs related tasks to prepare entire launching ways to launch a ship. Gets all material and timber salvaged after launching for use in subsequent operation.
